phase_title: 実測入力データの証跡固定・改変防止ルール設計
phase_purpose: Phase 16 実測入力データエントリ受領・検証層：Phase 16-1 で受領した実測入力データに対して、改ざんやタイムスタンプ改変を防ぐための証跡固定（ハッシュ化、デジタルタイムスタンプ、監査ログ）ルールを設計する
execution_context: reports-only design phase; design of evidence lock and tamper prevention mechanisms only, no actual locking or prevention execution yet

governance.safety_rule: All blocked_actions remain strictly prohibited. Evidence lock and tamper prevention is design-only; no actual data locking or protection mechanisms are activated. No app/tests implementation permitted.
governance.hard_stop_condition: This phase is design-only. No actual data immutability or protection mechanisms are enforced.

evidence_lock_purpose.purpose: Create immutable, tamper-evident record of Phase 15-1 and Phase 15-2 human review input data from receipt through validation and measurement workflows
protection_mechanisms: Digital timestamp (optional TSA for external timestamp)
Tamper detection (hash change detection, signature verification)
evidence_lock_purpose.goal: Ensure that if data is modified or timestamp manipulated after receipt, modification is detectable before Phase 15-7/15-8 measurement workflows execute

cryptographic_hashing_rules.hash_purpose: Create cryptographic fingerprint of Phase 15-1 and Phase 15-2 data at receipt time

hash_algorithm.rule: Hash algorithm must be cryptographically secure and collision-resistant

hash_input_specification.rule: Hash must be computed over complete, normalized data payload
hash_input_specification.normalization: Canonical JSON (deterministic field ordering, no extra whitespace) or binary exact copy
hash_computation_steps: 1. Take Phase 15-1 or Phase 15-2 complete data payload
2. Normalize if text (e.g., canonical JSON format)

hash_storage.rule: Hash must be stored alongside receipt record with metadata

storage_fields.data_hash_phase_15_1: Hex-encoded SHA-256 hash of Phase 15-1 data payload
storage_fields.data_hash_phase_15_2: Hex-encoded SHA-256 hash of Phase 15-2 data payload
storage_fields.hash_computation_timestamp: When hash was computed (must match or precede receipt timestamp)

procedure: 3. Recompute hash of current data payload using same algorithm
5. If hashes match: data integrity OK; if mismatch: TAMPERED DETECTED
hash_verification_procedure.tamper_detection: If hash mismatch detected, data has been modified; trigger alert and halt further processing

digital_timestamp_rules.timestamp_purpose: Create external, independent timestamp of data receipt to prevent backdating or timestamp manipulation

option_1_system_timestamp.method: Record system time (UTC) at receipt and hash computation
option_1_system_timestamp.disadvantage: Could be manipulated if system clock is compromised

option_2_tsa_digital_timestamp.method: Use Time Stamping Authority (TSA) per RFC 3161 for external, independent timestamp
option_2_tsa_digital_timestamp.advantage: External authority proves timestamp; tamper-evident if TSA communication logged
option_2_tsa_digital_timestamp.disadvantage: Requires external service call; design-phase note: 'external_api_call' is blocked for actual execution
option_2_tsa_digital_timestamp.design_note: This is design specification only; actual TSA call would require unblocking external_api_call

option_3_blockchain_or_distributed_ledge.method: Record hash or timestamp on immutable distributed ledger
option_3_blockchain_or_distributed_ledge.design_note: For future consideration; not implemented in initial design

digital_timestamp_rules.recommended_timestamp_mechanism: Option 1 (system UTC timestamp) as primary; Option 2 (TSA) recommended if external API calls become permitted

storage_fields.receipt_system_timestamp: System UTC time when data was received
storage_fields.hash_computation_timestamp: System UTC time when hash was computed (must be >= receipt_system_timestamp)

procedure: 2. Verify timestamp order: receipt <= hash <= validation
3. Verify all timestamps are not in future relative to current time
4. Verify timestamp interval is reasonable (< 1 hour typical)
5. Check for timestamp gaps (e.g., hash timestamp far from receipt could indicate manipulation attempt)

audit_trail_logging_rules.audit_purpose: Create complete audit log of all accesses, reads, validations, and attempted modifications to Phase 15-1/15-2 data

log_entries.description: Data received via Phase 16-1 receipt channel
Cryptographic hash computed for integrity verification
Data read for validation or measurement workflow
Attempt to modify data (should be blocked)
Hash mismatch or integrity violation detected

audit_log_immutability.rule: Audit log must be append-only; entries cannot be deleted or modified after creation
audit_log_immutability.enforcement: Stored in append-only file, database with write-once constraints, or similar mechanism
audit_log_immutability.design_note: Implementation details TBD; design specifies requirement only

audit_log_retention.rule: Audit log must be retained for minimum period (e.g., 1 year after Phase 15-7/15-8 measurement completion)
audit_log_retention.retention_period: At least 1 year from measurement date

data_integrity_verification_rules.integrity_verification_purpose: Periodically verify data has not been tampered with by comparing current state to stored hash
verification_triggers: Periodically during storage (e.g., nightly background integrity checks)

steps.action: Retrieve hash computed at receipt time (data_hash_phase_15_1 or _15_2)
steps.requirement: Hash must exist and be non-empty

steps.action: Retrieve current data payload from storage
steps.requirement: Data must be accessible and parseable

steps.action: Recompute hash of current data using same algorithm
steps.requirement: Must use same algorithm as stored hash

steps.result_mismatch: TAMPER DETECTED; halt processing, alert security team, investigate

response_steps.requirement: Data must not be used for measurement or decision until investigation complete

response_steps.action: Alert security/audit team of tampering detection
response_steps.recipients: Security officer, Phase 16 authority, audit log

response_steps.action: Preserve both stored hash, current data state, and audit log for forensic analysis
response_steps.requirement: Create forensic backup before any remediation

response_steps.action: Determine root cause of tampering (malicious, accidental, system error)
response_steps.investigation: Review audit log, access controls, system logs

options: Option A: Restore from backup (if backup integrity verified)
Option B: Request data resubmission from reviewer
Option C: Escalate to human authority for decision

response_steps.action: Improve tamper prevention based on incident analysis

evidence_lock_state_tracking.lock_state_definition: Data is considered 'locked' when hash is computed and stored, integrity verification succeeds, and no modification is permitted

fields.phase_15_1_evidence_locked: boolean - Phase 15-1 data hash computed, stored, and verified OK
fields.phase_15_1_lock_timestamp: ISO8601 - when Phase 15-1 lock was established
fields.phase_15_2_evidence_locked: boolean - Phase 15-2 data hash computed, stored, and verified OK
fields.phase_15_2_lock_timestamp: ISO8601 - when Phase 15-2 lock was established

lock_state_transitions.transition_1: Hash computed → HASHED (but not yet verified)
lock_state_transitions.transition_3_alert: Hash mismatch detected → TAMPERING_DETECTED (alert issued, halt)

depends_on: Phase 16-4: Format validation (occurs after hash is computed)
feeds_into: Phase 16-2: Completeness/signature/consistency validation (requires data integrity verified)
Phase 16-3: Pre-decision update feasibility (requires lock state confirmed)
Phase 15-7: integrated_decision measurement (requires data integrity verified)
Phase 15-8: Permission measurement (requires data integrity verified)

design_review_checklist: Cryptographic hashing algorithm is strong (SHA-256 or better) and weak algorithms explicitly blocked
Hash input specification ensures canonical, deterministic computation
Hash storage includes algorithm identifier and computation timestamp
Hash verification procedure is clear and testable
Timestamp mechanisms are designed (system UTC primary, TSA optional for future)
Timestamp verification checks order and reasonableness
Audit trail captures all relevant events (receipt, hash, validation, reads, attempts, verification)
Audit log immutability is specified (append-only requirement)
Integrity verification triggers cover all critical points
Tamper response procedure is detailed with escalation path
Lock state tracking clearly defines locked/unlocked states and transitions
Design acknowledges this is design-only; actual locking mechanisms TBD for implementation
All blocked actions remain in governance

completion_gate.gate_condition: Evidence lock design approved AND tamper prevention mechanisms specified
completion_gate.approval_required: Human technical reviewer + Phase 16 design authority
completion_gate.prerequisite_for: Phase 16-6 (validation failure and return rules) can begin once evidence lock design is approved
